scene.lighting: soft, diffused, and natural, likely from a window or studio softbox
scene.camera_angle: shallow-depth-of-field close-up, slightly elevated, diagonal perspective
scene.color_palette: muted and earthy: beige, deep burgundy, dark brown or black, soft off-white

pages.texture: aged paper, slightly yellowed, soft creases from frequent use
pages.layout: open to a page with visible printed text in a traditional serif font

text.translation: standard English translation (e.g., King James Version)
text.legible_text: portions of scripture such as 'the mighty men of old' and 'the day shall be', chapter and verse numbers (e.g., 'Matthew 1:1' or 'Acts 1:1')

focus.center: sharp on the center of the pages and the bookmark
